config.name: x-entia-key
config.description: Optional. Free tier needs no key. Get one at entia.systems/mcp-setup for paid tools.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: Look up any business entity by name, CIF/NIF, EU VAT, or LEI. Free callers receive a trace-level identity preview; authenticated callers receive the full paid dossier.

params.name: q
params.description: Company name, CIF/NIF (B82846825), EU VAT (ESB82846825), or LEI (20 chars)

params.name: name
params.description: Alias for `q` — accepted for compatibility with clients that send `name`.

params.name: query
params.description: Alias for `q` — accepted for compatibility with clients that send `query`.

tools.name: search_entities
tools.description: Search verified entities across 10 countries by name, keyword, country, city or sector. Answers 'find me a dentist in Madrid' / 'list law firms in Barcelona'. `sector` is a closed vocabulary — see the enum; aliases such as `abogados` resolve to their canonical slug. Anonymous callers receive a trace-level preview (name + city); authenticated TRACE+ keys unlock full records.

params.name: q
params.description: Search query — company name or keywords

params.name: city
params.description: City name (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, London)

params.name: sector
params.description: Sector filter. Canonical: dental, legal, estetica, psicologia, medicos, talleres, veterinarios, reformas, inmobiliarias, asesorias, gimnasios… Aliases (abogados, salud, dentist, beautysalon…) resolve

tools.name: verify_vat
tools.description: Real-time EU VAT validation via VIES (27 countries). Returns {valid, name, address, vat_number, country}.

tools.name: zone_profile
tools.description: Socioeconomic profile of a Spanish postal code — 17 blocks: income, employment, demographics, business census, real estate, FTTH, poverty, tourism.

params.name: postal_code
params.description: Spanish 5-digit postal code (28013 = Madrid Gran Vía)

tools.name: get_competitors
tools.description: Find real competitors in the same sector and city. Ranked entities with identity + location + sector matching. Spain only on the public surface. `sector` is a closed vocabulary — see the enum; aliases such as `abogados` (the slug ENTIA uses in its own Entia Home URLs) resolve to their canonical slug.

params.name: city
params.description: City name in Spain (Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Sevilla, Bilbao)

params.name: sector
params.description: ENTIA sector slug. Canonical: dental, legal, estetica, psicologia, medicos, talleres, veterinarios, reformas, inmobiliarias, asesorias, gimnasios… Aliases (abogados, salud, dentist, beautysalon…) reso

tools.name: get_showcase
tools.description: Curated IBEX35 + EU entity examples. FREE — does not consume quota. Use to explore data depth.

tools.name: professional_lookup
tools.description: Verify professional registrations across 24 Spanish health/legal/psychology verticals. Returns colegiado number, college, specialty, status.

params.name: query
params.description: Professional name, colegiado number, or REPS identifier

tools.name: get_full_dossier
tools.description: Aggregator — 90+ fields about an entity in one call. Combines 4 ENTIA sources in parallel: identity, zone, BORME, VIES. Killer tool for due diligence/KYB.

params.name: query
params.description: Company name, CIF/NIF, EU VAT, or LEI

tools.name: get_platform_stats
tools.description: Live platform stats: entities count, countries, sources, homes published.

tools.name: run_risk_audit
tools.description: Run comprehensive AI-readiness + digital risk audit on any domain. Analyzes SSL, DNS, structured data, LLM visibility. Returns risk score 0-100. 5 req/min, 30s timeout.

tools.name: get_entia_home
tools.description: Retrieve the Schema.org JSON-LD @graph for a specific entity's Entia Home (machine layer at /v1/identity/{country}/{sector}/{city}/{slug}.jsonld). Requires country, sector, city, slug path segments — not cif/q. Obtain the path via entity_lookup / showcase (canonical_url). Fail-closed: never returns ENTIA corporate marketing as if it were the entity.

tools.name: get_entity_home_projection
tools.description: Read the materializer snapshot entia.entity_home_projection.v1 for an Entia Home (claims + projection + policy). Same truth as the public ficha HTML/JSON-LD twin. Serve from R2 sibling .projection.v1.json — no ad-hoc MCP enrichment.

params.name: include_render_context
params.description: If true, keep render_context (large). Default strips it for agents.
